versions.changelog:
Initial release of Twitter Command Center (Search + Post):

- Enables real-time search, extraction, and publishing of tweets/replies using SkillBoss API Hub and a single API key.
- Supports monitoring influencers, tracking trends, social listening, automated engagement, and competitor intelligence.
- Provides comprehensive read (no login required) and write (login required) operations both via APIs and Python client.
- Includes sample curl and Python commands for rapid integration.
- Clearly details endpoint references, pricing per request, and setup instructions.
